sourceBrief.section: 7.7 UP-05 — accepted messages, queue recovery and truthful completion
sourceBrief.acceptance: An accepted message remains queued while its recipient is paused; resuming and restarting two recovery workers must promote at most one successor and preserve one real delivery/effect.

success.result: 1 test passed, 307 skipped, 1 test file passed; exit 0; duration 39.65s; selected case duration 22.32s
success.fixtureScope: temporary/test PostgreSQL database, actual dispatcher/reconciler in fresh tsx child processes, controlled registered adapter. Adapter writes a real issue comment and updates the Task through the original issue service. This is software test evidence, not provider qualification.

initialFailure.result: 1 test failed, 307 skipped; parent test expected a succeeded run but observed running after successor dispatch.
initialFailure.diagnosis: The recovery worker process dispatched the successor in its own process, while the original harness expected a parent-process mock adapter to execute/drain it. The test harness had no ownership of the child execution. Replaced that mock-only proof with a child-registered adapter and drainActiveRunExecutions() before child client shutdown. No production dispatch/Stop/lease policy changed.
initialFailure.boundedFacts: The retained failure output establishes status=running at assertion time. It does not contain PID/controller/wakeup/effect diagnostics; those were added to the harness after this failure.

unarchivedInitialParserFailure: The first marker-parser harness failure (Unexpected token '}' while parsing child output) was not retained as a raw log. It was a harness-only failure before assertions; no claims rely on it.

coverageAudit.nextMinimalOriginalOwnerTest: Extend the accepted-recipient PostgreSQL worker case with a true Task Stop racing recovery/dispatch, then assert the accepted comment remains preserved, no successor effect is delivered, and the Stop-owned terminal/hold state is unchanged. The wake-queue adapter has the narrower non-drain case already; the missing evidence is the same Stop race composed through heartbeat worker dispatch and its actual effect boundary.

Add a focused case through original native-finalization/recovery owners if root chooses that next; do not duplicate the separate cleanup-attempt owner test.
